events.verdict: Green (CHA) and Filipowski (UTA) engage and disengage with one another after the release of the shot attempt.
Green (CHA) is firming up in Filipowski's (UTA) path and absorbs contact during the shot attempt.
Williams (CHA) establishes a screening position in Sensabaugh's (UTA) path and does not deliver illegal contact.
Springer (UTA) is moving alongside Bridges' (CHA) path and the contact to Bridges' left side as he releases the pass is marginal.
Collier (UTA) reaches in and makes contact with the ball and any contact with Salaun (CHA) prior to the contact to the ball is marginal.
Filipowski (UTA) places a forearm against Simpson (CHA) and the contact during his shot attempt is marginal.
Williams (CHA) lowers his right hand toward the ball and cleanly dislodges it prior to incidental arm contact occurring with Collier (UTA).
Collier (UTA) lunges toward the ball with his right hand placed on Simpson's (CHA) back and the contact that occurs inside mid-court is marginal.
Bridges (CHA) establishes a screening position in Collier's (UTA) path and does not deliver illegal contact during the pick.
Sensabaugh (UTA) moves to align alongside Simpson's (CHA) path and the body contact that occurs after Simpson's gather is marginal.
Williams (CHA) makes incidental arm contact with Filipowski (UTA) as they each elevate for the rebound.
Salaun (CHA) legally contests Filipowski's (UTA) jump shot attempt.
Simpson (CHA) places his arm against George (UTA) during his put-back shot attempt and the contact is marginal.
Williams' (CHA) left arm extends out toward George (UTA) and the contact that occurs as Williams retrieves the rebound is marginal.
Sensabaugh (UTA) commits a take foul on Simpson (CHA).
Filipowski (UTA) commits a take foul on Green (CHA).
Green (CHA) legally contests George's (UTA) jump shot attempt.
Williams (CHA) makes clean contact with the ball and momentarily dislodges it away from Filipowski (UTA) prior to incidental arm contact occurring.
Sensabaugh (UTA) commits a take foul on Salaun (CHA).
Bridges (CHA) cleanly back-taps the rebound prior to incidental contact occurring with Springer (UTA).
